req.title: UK International Center - Admission Requirements (freshman: fee, English tests, deadlines, codes)

fsch.title: UK Student Success - Incoming Freshmen Scholarships

test_policy.notes: ACT/SAT are listed as optional tests for international freshmen but are required for engineering programs. International Bluegrass Scholarship tiers can use SAT 1200/1360 as an alternative to a higher GPA.

requirements.notes: UK International Application for Undergraduate Admission or the Common App; $60 non-refundable fee; official transcripts in English; English proficiency scores sent directly from the testing center.

deadlines.label: Priority deadline, fall 2027 (August start), international
deadlines.notes: The page prints 'December 1 for Fall semester (August start)' and no year, so it is taken as the current cycle; spring priority is Oct. 15. The freshman scholarship deadline is also Dec. 1 and funds can run out earlier.

deadlines.label: Freshman scholarship deadline (Bluegrass, William C. Parker)
International Ambassador Scholarship priority deadline
deadlines.notes: Requires supplementary materials and minimum GPA 2.5.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Citizens of a list of English-speaking countries are exempt from testing (list linked on the requirements page). The page lists the accepted tests only; conditional admission or an English pathway program is not described there.

english.notes: Tests taken on or before Jan. 20, 2026. TOEFL Essentials 7.5 is also accepted.
Tests taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026: 4 or above overall and in each subscore.

aid.notes: International freshmen admitted for fall are considered for the renewable Bluegrass Scholarship ($6,500 at 3.0 GPA; $10,000 at 3.5 or 3.0 with SAT 1200; $13,000 at 3.6 or 3.5 with SAT 1200; $16,000 at 3.8 or 3.5 with SAT 1360; deadline Dec. 1), the William C. Parker Scholarship (variable amount, holistic review of all applicants with GPA 3.0+, priority Dec. 1) and the International Ambassador Scholarship (listed as $3,000, min GPA 2.5, priority Feb. 15). Scholarships can be combined; none are awarded for spring. Need-based aid for internationals is not mentioned.

toefl.note: The requirements page asks that scores come directly from the testing center but prints no TOEFL code.

pte.note: PTE is not on the list of accepted tests for first-year applicants.

tier_notes.general: Public flagship with a 94% overall admit rate (90% for internationals) and SAT middle 50% of 1058-1270; large research university with an academic medical center.
